text: Inspect the pen crosshair and the labeled targets in each new image. Pick in idle. While lifted, locate S; while drawing, locate E. Compare the target with the tip separately along each unlocked axis. Left and above reduce the upper bound, right and below raise the lower bound; same locks the axis. Locks reflect previous answers, not verified alignment. Drop only when the tip is exactly at S, then use the reset search to locate E. Pick to submit only when the tip is exactly at E. Reinspect the image rather than repeating an action.
